decisions.reason: It moved from a simple mention to its own webpage, suggesting results at least around aspiration levels and enough strategic fit with the firm's core condenser business to justify continued support.

Its promotion to a dedicated page indicates satisfactory early feedback relative to expectations, and as a close extension of the established offer it uses familiar capabilities with limited additional risk.

Although still only mentioned rather than strongly promoted, it fits the firm's service and repair logic well, so with available organizational slack management would likely keep it unless demand clearly falls below aspiration.

As a customized product line with several models, it matches the firm's solution-oriented strategy and is likely retained because even moderate sales can be acceptable when it complements broader system and service business.

This repair-focused item is somewhat niche and less visibly emphasized, but it supports the installed base and lifecycle-service model, making retention more likely than withdrawal despite some uncertainty.
